title: `hint_screen_texture` and `hint_depth_texture` in the Compatibility renderer do not work in the vertex shader
body:
### Tested versions

- Tested in 4.7.1.stable, 4.8.beta1, from source (4d10419ca)

### System information

Godot v4.8.beta (4d10419ca) - Windows 11 (build 22621) - Multi-window, 3 monitors (2560x1440 @ 144.00 Hz, 1920x1080 @ 60.00 Hz, 1920x1080 @ 120.00 Hz) - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1062) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 47.92 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Trying to sample from the screen texture or depth texture in a vertex shader fails to compile on the Compatibility renderer. Returns the error `undefined variable "color_buffer"` / `undefined variable "depth_buffer"`. 

I know that this works in the Mobile and Forward+ renderers, its strictly an error in the Compatibility renderer.


from source, I added the `color_buffer` and `depth_buffer` sampler uniforms into the gles3 scene.glsl's vertex section and it worked fine for my use case, so I don't know if this is just someone forgot to put them there? I know its an extremely odd usage.

### Steps to reproduce

In a Compatibility renderer project, make a spatial or canvas item shader and add the screen texture uniform with hint_screen_texture (or depth) and sample it in the vertex shader. You don't have to then use it in the fragment shader.
